$comment: Exact pin of the FinancialPlanning finplan-platform package consumed by FinanceModel (forward runner: finplan_platform.core.modeling_evidence, the authoritative beta experiment ledger). Vendored byte for byte like finplan-contracts (contracts-pin.json): the wheel is the reproducible build (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=315532800, `uv build --wheel` of `git archive` of source_commit) of the FinancialPlanning repository; its SHA-256 is also recorded in uv.lock, which uv verifies on install. The package version is not bumped by FinancialPlanning, so source_commit identifies the content and sha256 identifies the bytes. It is not a contract package: the contracts 0.x beta-only rule does not apply, and the only consumer (the forward runner) is deployed in beta only.
source: FinancialPlanning repository (pyproject finplan-platform, packages platform/finplan_platform), built with: git archive <source_commit> | tar -x; SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=315532800 uv build --wheel
